name: healthathon-bpjs-monorepo
description: Production-grade fullstack monorepo for HealthAthon BPJS with React Vite and Express TypeScript

scripts.build: npm --workspace=@healthathon/shared run build && npm --workspace=@healthathon/api run build && npm --workspace=@healthathon/web run build
scripts.build:api: npm --workspace=@healthathon/shared run build && npm --workspace=@healthathon/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@healthathon/shared run build && npm --workspace=@healthathon/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@healthathon/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@healthathon/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@healthathon/web run typecheck
